matches.name: case-folded
matches.why: Both lowercased: a term in capitals finds a value in mixed case.

matches.name: no-match
matches.why: A term the text doesn't contain.

matches.name: null-never-matches
matches.why: A NULL never matches, though it's drawn `NULL`: a placeholder, not text.

matches.name: float-exact-text
matches.why: A float matches by its exact text (shortest round-trip), digits the cell rounds away included.

matches.name: float-exponent
matches.why: A very large float's exact text has an exponent, written as the table writes it (`1e300`), not DuckDB's `1e+300`.

matches.name: float-exponent-sign
matches.why: The table's exact text has no `+` in an exponent: DuckDB's text would match this, the table's doesn't (the README's two texts).

matches.name: sigma-inside-a-word
matches.why: A term's final sigma matches a word's sigma that isn't final: both sides lowercased with `ς` as `σ`, as a SQL `lower` writes it.

matches.name: lone-sigma
matches.why: A lone `Σ` lowercases to `σ`, and a word's final `ς` is taken as `σ`: the letter matches the word.

matches.name: past-the-cut
matches.why: The exact text matches whatever the cell cuts: a term past the "…" matches.

matches.name: final-sigma
matches.why: `str::to_lowercase` writes a final sigma `ς` on both sides: a term typed in capitals matches the same word.

ranges.name: plain
ranges.why: Each occurrence of the term in the drawn text, as byte ranges, in order.

ranges.name: case-folded
ranges.why: The ranges are found folded too.

ranges.name: rounded-shows-it
ranges.why: A rounded float whose drawn text shows the term: its range in the drawn text.

ranges.name: rounded-hides-it
ranges.why: A rounded float that matches, its drawn text not showing the term: the whole cell.

ranges.name: formatted
ranges.why: A formatted text (`format`) is the drawn text: its ranges are of it, grouping and all.

ranges.name: formatted-hides-it
ranges.why: The exact text matches, the format's grouping splits the term in the drawn: the whole cell.

ranges.name: cut-at-the-end
ranges.why: A term before the "…": its range in the cut text.

ranges.name: past-the-cut
ranges.why: A match past the "…": the drawn text doesn't show it, so the whole cell.

ranges.name: cut-in-the-middle
ranges.why: An integer cut in the middle: a term after the "…" (three bytes) is ranged in the drawn text.

ranges.name: longer-fold
ranges.why: `İ` folds to three bytes from two: the range maps back to whole characters of the drawn text.

ranges.name: inside-a-fold
ranges.why: A term inside one character's fold takes the character whole.

ranges.name: final-sigma
ranges.why: A final sigma folds as any sigma: a term typed with `ς` ranges the word written in capitals.

ranges.name: no-match
ranges.why: A cell that doesn't match draws nothing, whatever its drawn text.

steps.name: from-the-top
steps.why: With no start but the view's top row, the top row's first cell is searched first.

steps.name: along-the-row-then-down
steps.why: From the current match: the rest of its row in drawn order, then the next row's.

steps.name: drawn-order
steps.why: A moved column's order is followed: row 1 is searched 2, 0, 1, so after its column 2 come columns 0 and 1, then row 2.

steps.name: view-top
steps.why: From the view's top row, after the row above's last cell: the top row's matches come first.

steps.name: backward
steps.why: Backward: left along the row, then the row above's last.

steps.name: view-top-backward
steps.why: Backward from the view's top row: before its first cell, so the rows above it.

steps.name: wrap-forward
steps.why: No match to the end: a second ask from the top, up to the start cell.

steps.name: wrap-backward
steps.why: No match to the top: a second ask from the last row's last cell, up to the start cell.

steps.name: lone-match-found-again
steps.why: The second ask includes the start cell, so a lone match is found again.

steps.name: no-wrap-from-the-first-row
steps.why: A step forward from before the first row's first cell has searched every row: no second ask.

steps.name: hidden-not-searched
steps.why: A hidden column isn't in the query: `pear` is only in it.

steps.name: start-on-hidden
steps.why: A current match on a column hidden since is taken at the nearest shown cell before it: forward, after row 1's column 0.

steps.name: start-on-hidden-backward
steps.why: Backward, before the nearest shown cell after it: row 1's column 2, so column 0 first.
